title: Preset transfer begins at initialization and keeps the paired correction apparatus
statement: The whole preset-bank review accepts fixed/exogenous-time recovery of an already encoded unknown Q at B after startup, under the actual continuously corrected covariant router. Every routing clock starts at zero; B may be arbitrary but independent of the logical input. Direct paired quantum couplers and powered correction are paid. One fixed B decoder corrects the coherent spare/routing/bath span. This begins at initialization and supplies neither later request semantics nor detached receiver memory or a physical decoder.

requires: Already encoded unknown Q, admitted ready memory apparatus and every routing clock initialized to zero.
Direct paired Q/B quantum SWAP and correction couplers, fixed enlarged local dimension, always-enabled routing and powered correction across both banks.
The unified idempotent-payload Q memory, not the AB rollback Bell buffer; pointwise incident joint-cb noise and actual normal propagator/compression premises.
One fixed ideal ordinary B decoder at eligible fixed/exogenous times after startup; arbitrary logical-independent spare/clock/bath correlations are allowed.
